exposure: induction of labor in twin pregnancies
outcome: maternal morbidity (including estimated blood loss >1500 ml, blood transfusion, hysterectomy, intensive care unit admission, or maternal death)
cohort: Twin pregnancies ≥24 weeks’ gestation undergoing labor induction from 2011 to 2016.
finding: Multiparous women and those under 35 years of age were more likely to have a vaginal delivery after labor induction.
